articles.summary: DURHAM, N.C., Oct. 28, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Bioventus Inc. (Nasdaq: BVS) (“Bioventus” or the “Company”), a global leader in innovations for active healing, today announced that it will report financial results for the third quarter of fiscal year 2025 before the market opens on Tuesday,
articles.title: Bioventus to Report Third Quarter of Fiscal Year 2025 Financial Results on November 4, 2025
